name: Mangaluru
registryBasis: Mangalore City Corporation’s own citizen-services portal identifies itself as an official MCC service, lists its Mangaluru address, and provides municipal property-tax services including registering a new property. This supports a city-specific municipal property register, not a public land-title parcel map.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The municipal portal exposes citizen transactions and tax services; no anonymous geometry-only parcel schema or full-polygon route was identified. No property identifier, address, owner or tax record was entered or queried.
scopeLimits: Evidence supports Mangalore City Corporation’s municipal property registration/tax service. It does not establish the completeness or legal scope of a land-title cadastre, nor vector parcel coverage.
remainingUncertainty: No city parcel geometry, public feature schema, or geometry-only endpoint was verified. The property-services portal should not be treated as a public cadastral geometry feed.
